verdict.rationale: Graphite's pricing page lists an "Automations" feature, and Graphite Agent automatically reviews every new PR in the selected repos (a fixed event-triggered action). Users can also write custom review rules and exclusions, but these guide review content rather than trigger actions on events. The inbox "custom filters and rules" item covers organizing PRs, not automation. Missing for 10: documentation of the Automations feature (what events, conditions and actions can be defined), user-configurable event-to-action rules beyond auto-review, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.
